decisions.statement: A secret refused and a store that did not answer are two outcomes rather than one outcome.
A minting reads the session on the request before it reads any account.
A call handing over no request is read by its account alone.
A call naming no contributor and no account mints nothing and revokes nothing.
The route answers each of the three outcomes with a status of its own.

definition: whoever a presented device secret represents, and the refusals short of one
